title: Roblox Explosion
blurb: Every Roblox player of a certain vintage knows this boom — the default explosion baked into the engine, heard through rocket launchers, bombs and whatever the local exploiter was doing to the lobby. It is compressed, slightly crunchy and unmistakably 2010s Roblox, which is now nostalgic in the same way early YouTube audio is. The platform's stock sound library became a shared childhood soundtrack for a whole generation, and this is one of its loudest entries. Excellent for ending a Discord conversation or scoring something going catastrophically wrong.
origin: The classic default explosion sound effect from Roblox.
